meta.name: lighthouse
meta.description: Lighthouse audit + improvement loop until targets met. Triggers "lighthouse", "performance audit", "page speed", "improve scores", "LCP", "CLS", "INP", "core web vitals".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计网页性能并持续优化直至达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站需要提升Core Web Vitals评分。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit web performance and improve until targets are met.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website needs to improve Core Web Vitals scores.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude可以自动对指定网页进行Lighthouse性能审计，通过多次测试（3次移动+3次桌面）取平均分，分析失败项目，实施一次一项的修复，并重新审计，同时用截图检查界面是否被破坏，直到所有分数达标。
howto.when: 当用户提到“lighthouse”、“performance audit”、“page speed”、“improve scores”等关键词，或要求优化网页性能时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically run Lighthouse audits on a given URL, compute averages from 3 mobile and 3 desktop runs, identify failing audits, implement one fix at a time, re-audit, and visually check for regressions until all target scores are met.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'lighthouse', 'performance audit', 'page speed', 'improve scores', or asks to optimize a webpage.

say_en.text: Audit this URL with Lighthouse: https://example.com
Optimize the page; target LCP under 2.5s

say_en.note: Claude will loop improvements until met.
